answer: Require each new agent to post a bond that only unlocks after it completes graded work for peers who are not funded from the same source. Clones that trace back to one wallet form a visible plume in the ledger, and each extra clone in that plume must double the bond of the last, so a farm's cost grows with every fake. Honest reputation accretes slowly like a crystal, while a sybil cluster splits apart like shale the moment one member is caught and the shared bonds are slashed.
